At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

HUB BU HR Business Partner - EPIP Europe

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and implement people strategy through the execution of HR processes. Each day, you will provide HR support for a defined team or location, by partnering with respective managers. You will also showcase your expertise by representing HR in the business and establishing strong relationships with all business leaders and employees.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the overall success of the ELIP Site in Uster. Main stakeholders are local site Management team and the European Leadership Team


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supporting the business and the execution of HR processes involved across the end-to-end employee lifecycle

  • Determines and delivers the best approach in the area of responsibility and executes the HR priorities

  • Ensures effective communication, engagement, and collaboration across the organization

  • Facilitating change management initiatives and driving behavior change & continuous improvement across the respective business area / area of responsibility.

  • Supports the organization and the execution of HR processes involved across the end-to-end employee lifecycle

  • Leading and execution of HR initiatives and projects locally and work within the ELIP organization


Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed vocational training or university degree with proven track record as HRBP or HR generalist within a production environment for a minimum of five years

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of MS-office and Workday /SAP

  • Highly self-driven and autonomous with a strong sense of ownership and executions focus

  • Ability to communicate at all levels and hands on mentality

  • You are at ease communicating in German and English ( written and oral)

More about us

We develop cable protection systems for a wide range of market segments worldwide. Our goal is to further strengthen our position in our target markets through targeted development and continuous improvement of our solutions.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner ABB Switzerland Ltd.

If you want to know more about ABB, please visit our website:
www.abb.com

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products. We would like to give a motivated student an opportunity to complete a six-month internship with a multidisciplinary team at the Energy Storage group of ABB.

At ABB, we envision integration of Energy Storage systems for reliable and sustainable electrical mobility applications as well as for the power grids of the future. To realize this vision, we are developing advanced technological solutions that are based on various battery cell chemistries.

As an intern, you will contribute to advanced research projects in battery technology and advanced manufacturing.

• Your responsibilities will include:

  • Polymer Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing):
  • Operate and support polymer 3D printing processes using state‑of‑the‑art industrial-grade equipment for prototyping and functional components.
  • Development of Battery Test Setups:
  • Assist in the design, development, and assembly of battery test systems. This includes practical work such as designing innovative cell holders, building fixtures, and supporting laser-welding jig development.
  • Testing Operations & Data Analysis:
  • Support test maintenance, launch activities, and experimental campaigns. Collect, process, and analyze test data to contribute to research outcomes.
  • Battery Safety Testing Preparation:
  • Assist in the preparation of battery safety tests, including setup and integration of sensing and measurement equipment.
  • Research Support on Novel Battery Concepts:
  • Contribute to ongoing research activities focused on next-generation battery technologies, including experimental validation and documentation.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Master`s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar field
  • Interest in battery energy storage & state of the art technologies
  • Experience with CAD and additive manufacturing is required. Already maturated practical experience in a lab setting and working knowledge of Python is preferred
  • Proficiency in English
  • Willingness to learn and explore new research topics
  • Committed to learning and taking initiative
  • Ability to think conceptually and express ideas clearly and convincingly
  • Availability for six months (start and end dates are open for discussion)

Application Details:

Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that a certificate from your university, showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies, is required for the visa application.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

Quality Manager


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the quality strategy for a local organizational unit, including quality culture, systems, tools, and skilled teams, with the aim to meet customer expectations while ensuring sustainable operations. Each day, you will assist the organization in creating the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your skills by collaborating with local functions that improve the quality of results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class performance.

The work model for the role is onsite. #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Power Protection, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Non-Conformities Management: Analyze non-conformities systematically to identify root causes and initiate cases in the Practical Problem Solving (PPS) tool to track corrective activities and ensure resolution.

Gestionnaire de la qualité


Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion d'appuyer le déploiement de la stratégie de qualité pour une unité organisationnelle locale, y compris la culture de qualité, les systèmes, les outils et les équipes compétentes, dans le but de répondre aux attentes des clients tout en assurant des opérations durables. Chaque jour, vous aiderez l'organisation à créer le bon mélange de prévention, d'amélioration continue, d'analyse robuste des causes profondes, de réponse rapide et de solutions durables aux problèmes. Vous présenterez également vos compétences en collaborant avec des fonctions locales qui améliorent la qualité des résultats pour atteindre les objectifs de l'unité organisationnelle et viser un rendement de calibre mondial.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est sur place. #LI-Onsite

Ce rôle contribue à la division Power Protection, Smart Power à Quartino, en Suisse.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Gestion des non-conformités: Analyser systématiquement les non-conformités afin d'identifier les causes profondes et d'initier les cas dans l'outil de résolution des problèmes pratiques (SPP) afin de suivre les activités correctives et d'assurer leur résolution.

  • SPP Gestion des cas : Définir les mesures de confinement, de correction et de prévention. Faciliter les cercles de qualité de niveau 2 et faire passer les cas critiques au niveau 3, au besoin.

  • Qualité Performance de l'ICP : contribuer à l'amélioration des principales mesures de qualité, y compris la fabrication du rendement du premier passage (APP), le PPM du fournisseur, le PPU du client et le coût global de la mauvaise qualité (DPQ). Surveiller et assurer la fermeture en temps opportun des cas de SP.

  • Gestion de la qualité des fournisseurs : Gérer les non-conformités des fournisseurs et cerner les principaux problèmes critiques en collaboration avec le gestionnaire de la qualité des fournisseurs afin d'améliorer les initiatives.

  • Soutien à la production : Soutenir les techniciens de la qualité en identifiant les possibilités d'amélioration pour prévenir les non-conformités et minimiser les perturbations de la production.

  • Développement de barrières de qualité : Élaborer de nouvelles barrières de qualité et améliorer continuellement les pratiques existantes pour améliorer la qualité des produits et le contrôle des procédés.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Bachelor's degree or SSST in Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • Minimum cinq années d'expérience en qualité ou en rôle équivalent.

  • Compréhension approfondie des processus de qualité, y compris les méthodes de résolution de problèmes et les outils d'amélioration continue.

  • Compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux organisationnels. Volonté de travailler au-delà des heures normales, au besoin, et capacité de fonctionner efficacement dans des situations exigeantes.

  • Capacité démontrée de gérer les tâches efficacement et en collaboration dans un environnement de fabrication en constante évolution, caractérisé par des ajustements et des changements réguliers.

  • Fluency in English and Italian (written and please).

  • La certification Six Sigma Green Belt est considérée comme un avantage.



Plus sur nous

ABB Smart Power est un leader technologique mondial, avec des produits et des solutions qui font des alimentations électriques intelligentes, connectées et protégées. Ses produits et solutions intelligents rendent l'énergie plus compétitive en améliorant l'efficacité énergétique, la productivité et la fiabilité de presque toutes les opérations.

IS Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to own software solution architecture across multiple architecture categories and ensure its alignment with enterprise and data architecture standards. Each day, you will be responsible for the design and build, integrity, and quality of an Information Systems (IS) solution and associated IS services delivered to business. You will also showcase your expertise by consulting, advising, and supporting on the installation of new IS solutions/services, or changing existing IS solutions/services.

  • Approving, signing-off, and building any solution to be implemented on ABB production environment, within the respective service line, ensuring required quality and safety standards.

  • Contributing to IS problem and incident management by identifying and eliminating the reoccurring defects.

  • Defining the technical IS solution and ensuring alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration among IS solution architects and IS delivery units.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship (EFZ) or equivalent qualification

  • Good communication skills in German and English (both written and spoken)

  • First professional experience is a plus (internship or entry-level experience)

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Basic knowledge of MS Office (e.g., Outlook, Excel, Teams)

This recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Research Team Manager - Industrial Software Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes


Benefits

  • Flexible Work Practices
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Canteen

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Job Summary

Contributes to ensuring a safe working environment in compliance with company guidelines, guaranteeing the achievement of Production targets during the shift. Supports the Production Supervisors in the daily coordination of operational activities, providing technical assistance to operators in the testing areas.

Your Roles and • Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and ensuring compliance with ABB safety guidelines and Code of Conduct during the shift

  • Supporting the Production Supervisor to ensure the correct execution of production activities

  • Providing technical support to operators (Testing) during daily operations

  • Acting as the reference point for on‑the‑job training of production personnel

  • Serving as the first level of contact for operational issues to be escalated to the relevant Production Supervisor

  • Participating in Level 1 Q Circles: gathers technical and quality issues and communicating them to the appropriate supervisor

The work model for this role is on-site: #LI-Onsite

License to Operate / Core Values

  • Ensuring that all personnel (within the area of responsibility) understand ABB’s core values and the group’s safety and integrity standards, and act accordingly

  • Implementing and ensuring compliance with ABB’s Code of Conduct, tools, policies, and processes within the assigned area

Collaboration / Leadership

  • Promoting and enabling collaboration within the relevant work areas

  • Managing relationships with stakeholders in the area of responsibility and ensures alignment

Professional Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in operations, with experience in coordination roles

  • Experience in the electrical/electronic field

  • Previous experience in team coordination roles is considered a plus

Education

  • Vocational school diploma or equivalent

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Mara Werne, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, work instruction, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also demonstrate your skills by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to meet the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Power Protection

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Identifying and recommending improvement opportunities and implements improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost requirements.
  • Providing the necessary work instruction
  • Ensure product maintenance through the introduction of the engineering change notice
  • Approving the design for processes developed internally or externally and performing final tests with respect to the project.
  • Providing support to Production during the internal process/equipment start-up, defining action plans and training relevant maintenance and production resources.
  • Evaluating new process technologies to improve productivity, quality, and cost reduction, defining and managing testing activities, approval criteria, and external provider choices.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree in Electric/Mechanic Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in operation and production line activities.
  • Knowledge of Engineering & Manufacturing Processes.
  • Proficiency in MS Office; preferred are: 2D/3D CAD systems, sap and Windchill.
  • Knowledge of the English language.
  • Positive spirit, self-motivation, team working, efficiency and problem-solving orientation; focus on delivering results by taking responsibility for assigned tasks and projects

Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).
  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.
  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.
  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.
  • Contribution toward gym membership.

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Pedro Labian Sanchez.

  • Knowledge of environmental, reliability, and safety requirements for Industrial products.

descriptionByLocale.it: ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a superare - più snella e più pulita. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa - per voi, la vostra squadra, e il mondo. Come leader di mercato globale, vi daremo quello che dovete fare per farlo accadere. Non sarà sempre facile, la crescita prende grinta. Ma ad ABB, non correrete mai da soli. Gestisci quello che gestisce il mondo. Questa posizione riporta a: Direttore di produzione Il vostro ruolo e responsabilità Lo stabilimento di ABB Quartino fa parte della Critical Power Business Line, dove sviluppiamo e produciamo sistemi UPS progettati per stabilizzare e garantire la continuità dell'alimentazione della rete elettrica nelle strutture dei nostri clienti globali. La forte espansione del mercato e l'aumento atteso del volume nei prossimi anni richiedono un'espansione della nostra organizzazione di produzione. La struttura produttiva è organizzata in unità di produzione integrate (IPU), divise per tipo di prodotto. Ogni IPU è autonomamente organizzato in modo da poter coordinare in modo indipendente tutte le risorse necessarie per garantire i risultati di produzione richiesti, mantenendo la qualità e i costi previsti. Per uno dei nostri IPU stiamo cercando un Supervisore di Produzione che riferirà al Leader dell'IPU e lavorerà accanto alle altre IPU che coordinano le linee di prodotto assegnate. Garantirai risultati produttivi efficienti e convenienti che soddisfino la domanda d'ordine, le specifiche, la qualità e la pianificazione degli obiettivi attraverso il coordinamento e la gestione delle attrezzature, del personale e dei processi di produzione (quantità, qualità, costi e un corretto livello di produttività). Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: #LI- onsite Sarete principalmente responsabili per: - Gestione Operativa e di Produzione: Coordinate tutte le risorse di produzione, personale, attrezzature e area di produzione, per soddisfare obiettivi operativi chiave, tra cui l'output, la consegna in tempo reale e il rendimento del primo passaggio, partecipando attivamente ai progetti per ottimizzare le prestazioni e il capitale di lavoro. - Team Leadership & Development: Guida, guida e sviluppo di un team di produzione altamente performante assicurando un corretto personale e competenze, fornendo coaching e motivazione, e promuovendo una cultura collaborativa in linea con le politiche HR e i valori fondamentali di ABB. - HSE & Compliance ProprietÃ: Prendere la piena responsabilitÃ per la salute, la sicurezza e l'ambiente (HSE) del vostro team, valutare i rischi e i piani di attuazione per garantire il rigoroso rispetto di tutti gli standard di integrità ABB, le normative locali e il codice di condotta. - Miglioramento continuo e formazione: guidare una cultura di miglioramento continuo collaborando con i team di eccellenza operativa per integrare i principi della magra manifatturiera e Kaizen, garantendo al contempo l'implementazione di programmi di formazione necessari per la sicurezza, la tecnica e il processo per la vostra organizzazione. Qualifiche per il ruolo - Una laurea in una disciplina tecnica come Elettronica, Meccanica, o un campo correlato. - Una profonda comprensione dei processi produttivi end-to-end e della logistica in un ambiente di produzione. - Un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza comprovata in un ambiente di produzione, compreso il tempo significativo in un Team Leader o capacità di supervisione. - No. Almeno 3 anni di esperienza di leadership pratica, con responsabilità diretta per la gestione e lo sviluppo di team di produzione o personale di laboratorio. - Competenza dimostrata nella pianificazione delle risorse operative, inclusa l'organizzazione del personale, delle attrezzature di produzione e dei turni. - Forte leadership e competenze motivazionali, combinate con una comprovata capacità di gestire i conflitti e promuovere un ambiente di team collaborativo. ABB Smart Power offre soluzioni di distribuzione energetica per data center, impianti industriali e produttivi, infrastrutture critiche e edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della Divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, offrendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano obiettivi di crescita rapida, transizione energetica e sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS ad alta efficienza energetica. At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Production Manager Your role and responsibilities The ABB Quartino plant is part of the Critical Power Business Line, where we develop and produce UPS systems designed to stabilize and ensure continuity of power grid supply at our global customers' facilities. The strong market expansion and expected volume increase in the coming years require an expansion of our production organization. The production structure is organized in Integrated Production Units (IPUs), divided by product type. Each IPU is autonomously organized so it can independently coordinate all the resources needed to ensure the required production outputs, while maintaining the expected quality and costs. For one of our IPUs we are looking for a Production Supervisor that will report to the IPU Leader and will work alongside the other IPUs coordinating the assigned product lines. You will ensure efficient and cost-effective production results that meet order demand, specifications, quality, and planning targets through the coordination and management of plant equipment, personnel, and production processes (quantity, quality, costs, and proper productivity level). The work model for the role is: #LI- onsite You will be mainly accountable for: - Operational & Production Management: Coordinate all production resources—personnel, equipment, and production area—to meet key operational targets including output, On-Time Delivery, and First Pass Yield, while actively participating in projects to optimize performance and working capital. - Team Leadership & Development: Lead, guide, and develop a high-performing production team by ensuring proper staffing and skills, providing coaching and motivation, and fostering a collaborative culture in line with HR policies and ABB's core values. - HSE & Compliance Ownership: Take full accountability for the Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) of your team, assessing risks and implementing plans to ensure strict compliance with all ABB integrity standards, local regulations, and the code of conduct. - Continuous Improvement & Training: Drive a culture of continuous improvement by collaborating with Operational Excellence teams to integrate lean manufacturing and Kaizen principles, while ensuring the implementation of necessary safety, technical, and process-related training programs for your organization. 
• Qualifications for the role - A degree in a technical discipline such as Electronics, Mechanics, or a related field. - A deep understanding of end-to-end production processes and logistics within a manufacturing environment. - A minimum of 5 years of proven experience in a production environment, including significant time in a Team Leader or supervisory capacity. - At least 3 years of hands-on leadership experience, with direct responsibility for managing and developing production teams or shop-floor personnel. - Demonstrated expertise in operational resource planning, including the organization of personnel, production equipment, and shift schedules. - Strong leadership and motivational skills, combined with a proven ability to manage conflicts and foster a collaborative team environment. - Fluency in Italian is required; a good working knowledge of English is a valuable asset More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. We look forward to receiving your application. Learn more about ABB at www.abb.com . Read our Data Privacy Statement . We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Production Engineering Manager __ Your role and responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and maintain test infrastructures and test automations in accordance with business strategy to improve safety, efficiency, quality, and cost reduction. Each day, you will ensure existing test systems remain functional and up-to-date while designing new automated solutions for emerging products. You will also showcase your expertise by implementing innovative testing methodologies that enhance production standards and reduce costs. The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid You will be mainly accountable for: - Maintaining and improving existing test systems, both hardware infrastructures and software automations, ensuring they meet current operational standards. - Designing new test systems for new products in compliance with specifications and manual test procedures, implementing automation wherever possible. - Providing support for the integration and startup of test systems, defining action plans and training relevant personnel. - Identifying and recommending opportunities for improving test processes and implementing related projects, ensuring adherence to safety requirements and evaluating new technologies. Qualifications for the role - You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in UPS testing or commissioning, with proven expertise in test system development and maintenance. - Highly skilled in hardware design and automation software development, with the ability to create robust and efficient testing solutions. - Possess an enhanced knowledge of electrical infrastructures design and software development in C programming language. - You are passionate about workplace safety and technical documentation, ensuring all systems comply with safety requirements and are properly documented. - Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. - You are at ease communicating in English, both written and spoken. - Nice-to-have: Knowledge of programming languages such as LabVIEW, Python, and C#, experience with programming IDEs like LabWindows CVI and VSCode, and familiarity with hardware design software such as Altium. More about us ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en: At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Fulfillment Lead Your role and responsibilities Join ABB and become a vital part of our supply chain, ensuring the seamless flow of materials from our global suppliers to our production lines. In this critical role, you will be the central point of contact for purchasing and fulfillment, where your planning and problem-solving skills will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality products to our customers on time, every time. The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid You will be mainly responsible for - End-to-End Order Management: Manage the entire purchasing lifecycle within SAP, from creating and releasing purchase orders to actively monitoring and expediting them to align with production schedules and customer delivery deadlines. - Supplier Performance & Partnership: Drive supplier excellence by monitoring key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, quality, and lead times. You will conduct performance reviews and proactively resolve issues to strengthen our supply chain partnerships. - Logistics Coordination & Problem Solving: Oversee the inbound logistics process, including freight and customs clearance. You will be the go-to expert for handling urgent delivery situations and managing non-conformance reports to ensure operational continuity. - Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our fulfillment process by analyzing order backlogs, identifying root causes for delays, and implementing effective recovery plans. You will monitor and ensure the integrity of data exchanged through supplier EDI systems. Qualifications for the role - A degree or diploma in a technical field, Process Management, or Supply Chain Management. - Proven experience in a similar role within a manufacturing or industrial environment. - Strong, hands-on knowledge of SAP is essential for this role. - Excellent communication skills with fluency in both English and Italian. - A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic setting. - Experience with order handling, inventory management, and data analysis would be a significant advantage. More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
